description: Low/medium contention behavior and latency tail at 32 concurrent connections. Measures dispatcher behavior, thread contention, and latency distribution at moderate load.
loopback_caveat: Results are not equivalent to network-path benchmarks. transport_mode=loopback-h1 is mandatory in all result artifacts. Loopback saturates before network-path at this concurrency level.

concurrency.note: Fixed at 32 connections. Do not scale up — see concurrent-256 for high-contention scenario.

h3.reason: H3/QUIC requires dedicated QUIC toolchain not confirmed in runtime/drivers.
